title: If you are not particular about your decor than this may be to your liking.
text: If you are not particular about your decor than this may be to your liking.. Bought this for my master beds room.  Loved the design and colors.  HOWEVER! THE CRAFTMENSHIP is very poor.  The bedspread came with a multitude of long stringy threads clumped all over.  The seamstress evidently didn’t know how to use scissors.  For the money I expected better quality.  Therefore I gave it a lower rating. Also the pattern cannot be centered on any normal king or Calif. King bed.  It’s a shame with such a pretty pattern that the workman’s ship is so poor.
